recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-8825 unless a later work-group decision changes reference versioning rules or the ReferenceVersionRules value set.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition issue, raised for DSTU1 and applied for DSTU2, asking profiles to indicate whether references can or must be version-specific or version-independent. The accepted resolution was to add ElementDefinition.type.versioning with values for version specific, version independent, and don't care.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 8004. The matching git-svn commit 9e1eefd1d8be3b86f5fccfe3fbd7f6c46a4b1cc1, dated 2016-03-23, added ElementDefinition.type.versioning, ReferenceVersionRules, and the reference-version-rules code list to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-13101 is a same-change-family follow-up that made this model capturable by spreadsheet type declarations. Current source still defines type.versioning as ReferenceVersionRules with values either, independent, and specific; active ElementDefinition page content references type.versioning in an invariant; and the active Provenance relevant-history profile uses versioning="specific" on Provenance.target. Community searches found no directly relevant contrary evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk was needed because the requested model, code list, and active profile usage are already in current FHIR source.
